Raffle Picker

Pick raffle winners fairly with a Fisher-Yates shuffle — set the winner count, reveal them one by one, and export the results.

Each entry wins at most once.

–
Entries
–
Winners drawn

📖 How to use

  1. Paste one entry per line.
  2. Set how many winners to draw.
  3. Press Draw winners and reveal them, then download the results.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the draw fair?

Every entry is shuffled with the Fisher-Yates algorithm, then winners are taken from the top — each entry has an equal chance.

Can someone win twice?

Yes — each entry can win only once; winners are removed from the pool before the next pick.

How are winners shown?

Winners are highlighted in the draw order; remaining entries stay listed so you can audit the draw.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
